ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Client development, Terms signed and later stages need Search model and Fee percent.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Client_development", CASE(StageName, "Target", 1, "Conversation", 2, "Terms discussed", 3, "Terms sent", 4, "Terms signed", 5, 0) >= 5, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Search_model__c)), ISBLANK(Fee_percent__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Search model and Fee percent before moving to Terms signed.
